name: PalawanPay Trilogy Marathon 2026 – Palawan Leg
short_description: A full-marathon event held in Puerto Princesa City, Palawan, Philippines on October 18, 2026, organized by RUNRIO Inc. with PalawanPay as title sponsor.
ai_summary: The PalawanPay Trilogy Marathon 2026 – Palawan Leg is a full-marathon event scheduled for October 18, 2026, in Puerto Princesa City, Palawan, Philippines. Organized by RUNRIO Inc. with PalawanPay as title sponsor, the event offers multiple distances: 42.195km, 21.1km, 16km, 10km, and 5km. research_highlights: This October 18, 2026 Puerto Princesa leg is billed as the finale of a three-race trilogy (Manila Aug 9, Cebu Sept 27, Palawan Oct 18), and is the only leg offering the full 42KM marathon alongside all shorter distances.
The event has roots going back to 2015/2016 when it began as the 'Palawan Express Marathon,' the first full marathon held in Puerto Princesa and Palawan province.
The 2025 edition of the race (held June 15, 2025) drew over 2,100 runners, described as the largest turnout since the race series began in 2015, including participants from Australia and the USA.

Race proceeds are directed to a stated charitable cause: the trilogy's proceeds are earmarked for fully-equipped ambulances for underserved hospitals, with the 2025 edition's proceeds funding an ambulance for El Nido Community Hospital.

Puerto Princesa has a humid tropical climate typical of Palawan, with local weather data showing high humidity (around 88%) and 'feels like' temperatures well above 90°F even in the evening during the region's wet season, which participants should factor into race-day preparation.
research_watchouts: No first-hand participant race reports, reviews, or running-community discussion specific to this 2026 Palawan leg (or detailed course/organization reviews of the 2025 edition) were found in available sources — most coverage is organizer press releases and promotional announcements rather than runner feedback.
Specific cut-off times, start times, and detailed course-route information for the October 2026 Palawan leg were not found in available sources.

faqs.question: When is the PalawanPay Trilogy Marathon 2026 – Palawan Leg scheduled to take place?
faqs.answer: The event is scheduled for October 18, 2026. It will be held in Puerto Princesa City, located in Palawan, Philippines. This date marks the Palawan leg of the PalawanPay Trilogy Marathon series, organized by RUNRIO Inc. with PalawanPay serving as the title sponsor for the event.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at this race?
faqs.answer: The race offers five distance options for participants to choose from: a full marathon of 42.195km, a half marathon of 21.1km, plus 16km, 10km, and 5km distances. This range allows runners of different experience levels and fitness goals to take part in the Palawan leg event.

faqs.question: Who organizes the PalawanPay Trilogy Marathon?
faqs.answer: The event is organized by RUNRIO Inc., a race organizing company, with PalawanPay serving as the title sponsor. Together they are responsible for putting on this full-marathon event in Puerto Princesa City, Palawan, Philippines, scheduled to take place on October 18, 2026.
